name: Com ga
summary: Cơm gà is rice cooked in the chicken stock with a little turmeric, served with chicken boiled just done, herbs, cucumber, and a sweet-sour fish sauce. The rice is fragrant and slightly sticky, and the chicken firm and naturally sweet under a thin skin.
taste: Vietnam Airlines calls the rice fragrant and slightly sticky, and the chicken naturally sweet, with firm meat and a thin skin.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines: rice cooked in chicken-boiling water with a little pounded turmeric. Chicken boiled just done. Served with herbs, cucumber, and sweet-sour fish sauce. Some kitchens also serve cơm gà rô ti or cơm lòng gà.
seoTitle: Com ga in Quang Ngai — chicken rice
seoDescription: Quảng Ngãi chicken rice: turmeric rice cooked in the stock, chicken boiled just done, and a sweet-sour dip. 30,000–70,000 VND a portion.
